reason: The analyst reports a single specification restricted to the central region (N=661, a post-hoc subsample with outcome trimming and a thin control set) and generalizes it to 'no effect'. The full-sample estimate with proper pre-treatment controls is -0.28 (p=0.25), and the south region alone shows a significant negative effect (-0.91, p=0.016), so the central-only null is not a justified summary of the question.
